en.name: Cerenovus
en.ability: Each night, choose a player & a good character: they are “mad” they are this character tomorrow, or might be executed.
en.flavor: Reality is merely an opinion. Specifically, my opinion.

zh.ability: 每个夜晚，你要选择一名玩家和一个善良角色。他明天白天和夜晚需要“疯狂”地证明自己是这个角色，不然他可能被处决。
